info.title: LastDB relay protocol
info.description: Append-only log (except product erase); blobs; signed requests; spam/cost grant gate from publisher birth/grant entries; bundles via blob.put/get; no AcceptEntry on the relay; no snapshots.

post.summary: Append signed log entries (append-only; log/trim drops what a snapshot covers)

400.description: arg paths / grants.any.role / batch.response, entries.signature, incorporated_from

403.description: no current grant for this node_key / role

409.description: conflicting entry at an existing writer_seq

post.description: Requires nodeSignature. Accepted for the publisher, or for a current submit or write grant when the entries are data (proposal or direct) on the caller's own stream (the nodes decide whether a lease covers a direct entry; an uncovered one is stored and ignored), and for a current write grant when the entries are bundles on the caller's own stream; the publisher kinds, lease among them, are the publisher's alone. Revoke cuts off new appends immediately (403). Spam/cost gate only — not AcceptEntry.

post.summary: Read signed log entries from seq 1 or cursor

400.description: arg paths / grants.any.role / batch.response, entries.signature, incorporated_from

410.description: the entries from from_seq were dropped by a trim after a snapshot; restore from the snapshot

403.description: no current grant for this node_key / role

post.description: Requires nodeSignature. Allowed with a current read grant, or grant#any/read (any signed caller). Not unsigned/anonymous.

post.summary: List the device streams of one writer and the contiguous head of each

400.description: arg paths / grants.any.role / batch.response, entries.signature, incorporated_from

403.description: no current grant for this node_key / role

post.description: Requires nodeSignature. Allowed exactly when an all-devices log/read of the same writer_key is allowed (the same check decides both): a current read grant, the publisher, or grant#any/read. A caller with no grant, and a revoked member, get 403 forbidden. A writer with no stream gets an empty list, not an error. head_seq is the contiguous head: the highest writer_seq such that every sequence number from 1 up to it is stored on that stream; entries stored beyond a gap do not count until the gap is filled. head_hash is the entry hash of that entry. A stream whose seq 1 is not stored is not listed.

post.summary: Drop the entries that a snapshot covers (owner, personal database)

400.description: arg paths / grants.any.role / batch.response, entries.signature, incorporated_from

404.description: the named snapshot entry is not stored

403.description: caller is not the publisher (field publisher), or an entry that would be dropped is not sealed (field namespace)

post.description: Requires nodeSignature from the publisher. Names one snapshot entry on the snapshot stream. The relay reads that stored entry, checks its signature, and drops the entries up to each stream position in its through list, and the snapshot entries before it. It never drops a blob. Positions come only from the stored entry. A call does a bounded amount of work; repeat until done is true. Only sealed data and schema entries and snapshot entries are dropped.

400.description: arg paths / grants.any.role / batch.response, entries.signature, incorporated_from

403.description: no current grant for this node_key / role

post.description: Requires nodeSignature. Accepted for the publisher or a current write grant. Revoke cuts off new puts immediately (403). Spam/cost gate only — not AcceptEntry. Begin returns the presigned upload described by `Upload`; the relay never reads the uploaded bytes at commit, it confirms their length and `x-amz-checksum-sha256` recorded by the object store. A digest the relay already holds answers begin with HTTP 200 and no `upload`.

post.summary: Get blob via presigned URL only

400.description: arg paths / grants.any.role / batch.response, entries.signature, incorporated_from

403.description: no current grant for this node_key / role

post.description: Requires nodeSignature. Allowed with a current read grant, or grant#any/read (any signed caller). Not unsigned/anonymous.

post.summary: List the committed blobs of a database

400.description: arg paths / grants.any.role / batch.response, entries.signature, incorporated_from

403.description: caller may not read the database

post.description: Requires nodeSignature from a node that may read the database. Answers the committed blobs ascending by digest, at most 1,000 in a page. `next` is present when more follow; pass it as `after`.

post.summary: Drop the blobs the publisher names, while the stream heads it saw are the heads (personal database)

400.description: arg paths / grants.any.role / batch.response, entries.signature, incorporated_from

403.description: caller is not the publisher (field publisher), or the database has a grant (field grant)

409.description: a named stream is not as named (field `snapshot` for the snapshot stream, `heads` for a listed stream), or the publisher has a stream that the call does not name (field `heads`). Nothing was dropped

post.description: Requires nodeSignature from the publisher. `snapshot` names the head of the snapshot stream; the relay reads that stored entry, checks its signature and kind, and refuses a list that holds the manifest it names. `heads` are the stream heads the caller saw (the snapshot stream is not among them). One call is one step: every named stream still ends at the named entry and holds no entry above it, the publisher has no stream that the call does not name, each blob record that exists goes with its pending record, and the summed bytes are released once. A digest with no committed record is counted as `absent`. When a stream is not as named, or a stream of the publisher is not named, nothing is dropped and the answer is 409 `heads`.

SignedEntry.description: Opaque signed entry; store key (database_id,node_key,device_id,writer_seq). seen_heads may cite any stream by hash. A snapshot entry (kind snapshot, namespace snapshot) is signed by the publisher and carries manifest_sha256, manifest_bytes and through[] of {device_id,writer_seq,entry_hash,order}; the relay stores it like any publisher entry. A lease entry (kind lease, namespace lease) is signed by the publisher and carries expires_at_ms, closes_at_ms (later than expires_at_ms) and closed[] of {node_key,device_id,writer_seq}, ascending by node_key then device_id; the relay stores it unread, and only the publisher may append it.

Upload.description: A presigned single PUT. The client sends the file bytes with every header pair in `headers` except a `content-length` (the client sets its own, equal to the `bytes` of the begin request). `headers` carries `x-amz-checksum-sha256`, the base64 of the 32 bytes of the blob's SHA-256; the store or relay refuses a body of another length or digest (HTTP 400) and a request without that header. `content-type` may also appear. A client must not add other headers the relay did not return.

PresignedGet.description: Exactly one download path: presigned URL

head_seq.description: Highest writer_seq such that every sequence number from 1 up to it is stored on this stream

head_hash.description: Entry hash (SHA-256 of signed_bytes || signature) of the entry at head_seq

device_id.description: Hex32 id of the snapshot stream

writer_seq.description: Sequence number of the snapshot entry whose positions are dropped. Snapshot entries before it are dropped too; it and newer ones stay.

done.description: False when the call stopped at its work limit. Call again.

released_bytes.description: Length of the entries this call dropped, as the relay stored them. Exemem subtracts it from the publisher's quota counter. The node adds it to its account of what trims released (`cloud-usage.json`).

nodeSignature.name: X-LastDB-Signature
nodeSignature.description:
Ed25519 request signature. Signed material: POST
<path>
<protocol>
<node_key>
<database_id>
<body_sha256 hex>
<issued_at>
<nonce>. Companion headers: X-LastDB-Node-Key, X-LastDB-Database-Id, X-LastDB-Issued-At, X-LastDB-Nonce, X-LastDB-Relay-Protocol. Skew ±60s. Required on every relay request (including reads). grant#any means any signed caller may read — not unsigned access. Append/put also require a current write (or submit for proposals) grant; missing/bad sig → 401; no grant → 403 forbidden.
